entities.summary: Katherine Neville is a New York Times, USA Today and #1 internationally bestselling American author who writes adventure/quest novels. Her novels include The Eight (1988), A Calculated Risk (1992), The Magic Circle (1998) and The Fire (2008), which is a sequel to The Eight. Katherine Neville was a authors & novelists from St. Louis (b. 1945-04-04, St. Louis). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
